title: Carleman Estimates for Critical Electromagnetic Schrödinger Operators on Conic Manifolds
summary: We establish an $L^p$--$L^q$-type Carleman estimate for the Schrödinger operator $H_{A,V}$ with scaling-critical electromagnetic singular potentials on a conical singular space $(X,g)$ of dimension $d\geq3$, where the metric is $g=dr^2+r^2h$ and $X=C(Y)=(0,\infty)_r\times Y$ is a product cone over the closed Riemannian manifold $(Y,h)$. More precisely, we prove $$ \|e^{τφ}u\|_{L^{2d/(d-2)}(X)}\le C\,\|e^{τφ}H_{A,V}u\|_{L^{2d/(d+2)}(X)} $$ with the quadratic weight $φ(r)=\tfrac14(\log r)^2$, uniformly in $τ$.
